_why: NIGHT57 L (L0 / L2): n57-kiln's combat-room slots (NIGHT57.md L2, THE SLOTS) and, per new room, the n52-kiln room its slot replaces: Tools/night/n57-l-contract.sh runs that room's n46flow on n52-kiln (--off57) as the room's 'before' (THE ROOM CONTRACT's dwell item). Slots A / B / C replace kb2 / kb2c / kb3 in place (the same ids); the slot DE replaces n52's link kb3b (no fight) with two rooms, whose base is n52's last combat room kb3 (the fight they follow).
